mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical fourteen-period DeMarker ratio returning inside its 0.3/0.7 envelope on completed four-hour BTC auctions accompanied by exact twenty-four-hour OI contraction marks deleveraging exhaustion; follow the re-entry direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when DeMarker crosses strictly above 0.3 after being at or below 0.3; short when it crosses strictly below 0.7 after being at or above 0.7
mechanism.why_distinct: CCI standardizes typical price, stochastic locates close within range, and RSI smooths close changes. HVDEMOICR compares positive high expansion with positive low expansion through rolling DeMax/DeMin sums and trades only envelope re-entry confirmed by exact OI contraction, with no close oscillator, flow, volume, funding, fitted outcome, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour high/low expansion-pressure plus OI-contraction re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at T-24h and T with strict negative log(OI[T]/OI[T-24h])
features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.demarker: rolling 14-period DeMax sum divided by rolling DeMax plus DeMin sums, invalid at zero denominator
features.reentry: current ratio strictly crosses inward through 0.3 or 0.7 from immediately prior valid ratio
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical high-low expansion pressure re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no OI endpoint or contraction rule, DeMarker period, formula, level, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.fixed_definition: DeMax=max(high-prior high,0), DeMin=max(prior low-low,0), 14-period simple sums, ratio DeMax/(DeMax+DeMin), conventional 0.3/0.7 envelope re-entry
external_basis.selection_use: published period, formula, levels, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
